Quaid is an obtainable Unit in the game, as well as the leader of the Sacred Guardians of Meirith. He is a former adventurer who traveled from various places of Grand Gaia and an expert of swordsmanship. He is the main protagonist of the Grand Quest [[GQ:Quaid|The Correct Path]].


==Debut Appearance==


==In the storyline==


==Personality==
Quaid depicted as a brilliant and cheerful young man, much to Colt's annoyance. He is also shown as a dense person, as he is oblivious to Claire and Diana's feelings towards him.
